title: Chart of accounts
html:
Here you can add, modify and import the chart of accounts (the sample import file can be downloaded from the screen).

An account group has to be given for every account recorded in the master data — Infinity handles these groups during the individual transactions. The general ledger master data can be built up in a tree structure, with postable and non-postable (collective) accounts.

When creating the general ledger master data you can control whether posting to the given general ledger account has to be made at cost centre and job number level. If so, these have to be given obligatorily when the invoice is issued or when the automatic posting is defined.
